summary: V2 optimisations round: verified dark mode, home carousel, hot games covers, goods images, player rankings, game search, real trend chart, all lotteries seeded (60 periods each), back-to-top, dynamic titles, React Query caching, mobile home. Backend 22/22 pytest PASS (added banners/hotGames/goods.img/multi-lottery-seed assertions). Frontend: all requested data-testids present and functional except individual ranking-row data-testid missing on Home (Player Rankings block renders visually).
tests_performed: Backend: /api/home now includes banners[3]+hotGames[4]+hotGoods[4 with img]; /api/shop goods carry img; /api/draws returns 60 periods for gid=1,8,15 (jisu28/beijing28-keno-20nums/pk10-10nums). gid=999 empty. 22/22 pass.
Home: home-carousel + carousel-prev/next present and clickable; 4 home-hotgame-* with real cover images; 4 home-goods-* with real product images; Player Rankings section renders 8 rows visually.
Dark mode: theme-toggle flips html.dark class, body bg goes rgb(243,244,246) -> rgb(13,17,23), localStorage.theme='dark'. Toggle back returns to light bg. Persistence via localStorage verified.
Back-to-top: hidden initially, appears after window.scrollY>400 (verified at 700), click smooth-scrolls to y=0.
Dynamic titles: TITLE(home)='网站首页 · 胜利28...'; games='游戏乐园 · ...'; activities='活动专区 · ...'; rankings='牛人榜 · ...'; shop='兑换奖品 · ...'; user='用户中心 · ...'; partners='合作商家 · ...'. All change on route.
Games: game-search filters 34 tabs -> 10 tabs matching '北京'; clear restores 34; 'zzzzz' shows friendly '暂无/未找到' hint.
Tool-trend: opens overlay with 20 trend-row-* built from real 急速28 draws.
game-tab-8 (北京28 keno): draw-info-bar renders 20 numbers 3,5,10,13...,79 sum=18 correctly (no overflow/crash); history-table 26 rows; pagination '共 60 记录·共 3 页' (60/20=3 pages).
game-tab-15 (PK冠军): draw-info-bar renders 10 nums 4,5,7,3,2,1,10,6,8,9 sum=4 (no crash).
Regression: user sign-in tab click fires sign-btn -> disabled after; shop-buy-* fires sonner toast.
Mobile 390x844: home renders vertically stacked, no horizontal overflow (scrollWidth===clientWidth===390).
React Query cache: repeated navigation between pages produces no console errors.
action_items: MINOR: Home 'Player Rankings' block has no per-row data-testid (only menu-ranking exists on nav). Consider adding data-testid="home-rank-{i}" on each row for stable e2e verification. Not blocking — rows render correctly and visually verified in screenshots.
Sonner toast still lingers across route changes from previous iteration — carried over as a minor UX note (not re-raised).
critical_code_review_comments: BackToTop.jsx threshold 400 is fine; component correctly conditionally mounts.
useTheme + html.dark tailwind darkMode class strategy works; index.css .dark overrides applied. localStorage key 'theme' correctly persisted.
server.py seed v2: /api/home banners+hotGames added; goods.img wired; 26 lottery types × 60 periods loaded from draws_all.json. Startup seed is idempotent via meta.seeded_v2 flag.
GameNav.jsx retains empty-groups guard from iter5 — no regressions.
DrawInfoBar/HistoryTable correctly render both 3-ball 28-series and 20-ball keno / 10-ball PK10 payloads without overflow at 1920 desktop.
React Query wired in Home/GameArena/Shop/Rankings/Activities/Partners/UserCenter — no console errors on repeated navigation.
Consider adding data-testid on home Player Rankings rows for testability parity with other home sections (home-hotgame-*, home-goods-*, home-act-*).
seed_data_creation: None (server auto-seeds seeded_v2 flag on startup).
context_for_next_testing_agent: V2 fully green. Backend tests at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py assert 60 periods per lottery, banners/hotGames/goods.img presence. Dark mode verified via computed backgroundColor rgb(13,17,23). Only cosmetic gap: no per-row testid on Home Player Rankings block.
